The '''porkchop''' is a food item with the pack's "classic" porkchop model. It heals {{Hp|4}} the moment it is used, but the pack gives it no recipe, trade or drop: its only source is a loot table for the <code>/loot</code> command, and in 1.12.4 that table gives a plain [[Raw Porkchop|raw porkchop]] instead (see [[#Obtaining|Obtaining]]). It is a different item from the raw porkchop that pigs drop.

== Obtaining ==
The datapack has a loot table for it, <code>matcha:treasure/porkchop_classic</code>, which no chest, mob or trade uses. The table writes its components under the 26.3 key <code>modifier</code>, which Minecraft 26.2 ignores, so in 1.12.4 <code>/loot give @s loot matcha:treasure/porkchop_classic</code> gives an ordinary raw porkchop and the classic porkchop can't be obtained.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/treasure/porkchop_classic.json}}</ref> See [[Known bugs]].

{{Upcoming|the 26.3 port}}
In the 1.12.3 alpha for 26.3, and in the 26.3 port that continues it, the same table works and gives the classic porkchop.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/treasure/porkchop_classic.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref>

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
The item is a vanilla porkchop with a changed model (<code>matcha:porkchop_classic</code>) and the name "Porkchop". It is consumed at once, with no eating animation or sound, and applies Instant Health when used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/treasure/porkchop_classic.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.3|Added a loot table, <code>matcha:treasure/porkchop_classic</code>, to give the item with <code>/loot</code>. The <code>update_item</code> trigger now converts old classic porkchops to the new model.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/item_modifier/porkchop_classic.json}}</ref> The 26.2 release's table already used the 26.3 <code>modifier</code> key, so there it gave a plain raw porkchop.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/treasure/porkchop_classic.json|at=d7482cfd1cb9fbd4c633a6d030a954950c70f4d2}}</ref>}}
}}
